- **What I left out:** North team account notes and contracts that she can't see give a different renewal date. Pree isn't on the account's team and doesn't hold a company-wide role, so I didn't share it.
- **Next step:** I pointed her to Marcus to check the date against the contract. I offered to DM him the tip, clearly labelled as unverified. I haven't sent anything to him yet.
